collect.loadFailed: Data collection settings are temporarily unreadable.

sources.title: Collection sources
sources.desc: Turning one off stops new records of that kind; the ones already kept still feed learning until the retention policy below removes them. These switches belong to this device — every companion learns from the same records.

tool_calls.name: Tool calls
tool_calls.desc: Which tools were called in work sessions: only the tool name and the param shape (top-level arg names and types) — never arg values, never results.

chat_user_messages.name: Chat prompts
chat_user_messages.desc: The verbatim questions you send in conversations (very long ones are truncated).

requirements.name: Requirements
requirements.desc: Titles, descriptions and tags of requirements you create.

terminal_sessions.name: Terminal session metadata
terminal_sessions.desc: Terminal create/exit records — no commands and no output content.

companion_dialogues.name: Messages to companions
companion_dialogues.desc: The verbatim things you say to a desktop companion (long ones are truncated). The companion’s own replies are not recorded; replies stored by earlier versions still take up space but no longer feed learning, and the retention policy cleans them up. On by default.

retention.title: Retention policy
retention.desc: Retention is counted in local-date day-files, today included. These records belong to this device and are shared by every companion. An expired day-file is not deleted right away: it goes only once every enabled learning consumer of every companion (periodic learning, skill generation) has read that day. Only when every companion has both switched off does expired mean deleted.
retention.daysDesc: How many days raw events are kept at most ({{min}}–{{max}}).
retention.capacityDesc: A hard cap on the event directory ({{min}}–{{max}} MiB) that overrides retention: once usage exceeds it, the oldest day-files are deleted first, even if learning has not read them yet.
retention.empty: No collected event files are stored.
retention.lowerConfirm: Lowering retention or the storage limit runs a cleanup immediately, which may delete the oldest raw records and cannot be undone. These records are shared by every companion, so the cleanup affects all of them. Extracted memories and skills are kept. Continue?

stopAll.title: Stop everything
stopAll.desc: Turn off every collection source above and stop periodic learning and skill generation for every companion in one go.
stopAll.actionDesc: Switches only, no deletion: models and intervals stay as they are, learned skills and memories are kept, and already-collected raw records are still cleaned by the retention policy above. It stops learning for every companion, not just the one whose tab this is.
stopAll.confirm: Turn off every collection source and stop periodic learning and skill generation for every companion? You can re-enable at any time with no model reconfiguration. Already-collected raw records are not deleted.
stopAll.partial: Collection has stopped, but learning could not be stopped for some companions. Press again to retry — the ones already stopped are unaffected.
stopAll.failed: Could not turn things off. Please retry.

skills.sectionDesc: What this companion can do: the capabilities you granted from the catalog, plus the skills it distilled from real work.
skills.emptyDesc: Grant a capability from the catalog to start; your companion will also distill new skills from real work.
skills.catalogHint: Pick the capabilities to grant this companion from the skill catalog. Changes take effect on the next message.
skills.noDescription: This skill has no description yet
skills.configMissingHint: This skill is not currently installed. It will be restored automatically if installed again.
skills.draftReviewHint: Your companion just drafted this skill; it only takes effect in conversations once you accept it.
skills.acceptedOk: Accepted — the skill is now active
skills.rejectConfirmBody: Rejecting archives it; it won't be used in conversations.
skills.revokeHint: Revoking affects only this companion — the Skill stays in the catalog.
skills.taughtNone: Couldn't distill a skill from that session
skills.learnFromSessionHint: Paste the ID of a session where a multi-step task was completed and your companion will distill a draft skill from it for you to review.
skills.learnFromSessionInvalid: That doesn't look like a session ID — copy the full ID from the session's address bar.
skills.learnedFromSessionOk: Drafted a skill from that session — review it in the list
skills.learnedToast: Your companion learned a new skill

companions.empty: No companions yet — create your first one!
companions.emptyHint: Create a companion, give it a name and a figure, then set a model to start chatting.

overview.appearanceSectionHint: Its name, how it looks on your desktop, and how far it has come with you
overview.growthLevelHint: The longer you spend together, the higher its level — and the better it keeps up with your rhythm
overview.personaSectionHint: Who it is and how it speaks — written into the opening of every conversation
overview.modelSectionHint: Which model it thinks and replies with
overview.modelMissing: No chat model configured for {{companionName}} yet — it can't learn or chat.
overview.fallbackChatModelHint: Replays the turn once on this model when the main one fails.
overview.fallbackChatUnset: Not set. A failure on the main model is just a failure — no retry.
overview.vadSlotHint: The built-in Silero VAD, running locally, decides when you have finished speaking.
overview.asrSlotHint: The model that turns what this companion hears into text.
overview.asrFallback: Not set. Uses the global speech-recognition model from Model Management → Voice.
overview.visionSlotHint: Called on its own to look at images and camera frames.
overview.visionFallback: Not set. Uses the main chat model when that model can see images.
overview.ttsSlotHint: The model and voice that read replies out loud.
overview.ttsFallback: Not set. Uses the global speech-synthesis model and voice from Model Management → Voice.

memory.memorySectionHint: The memories this companion can recall while chatting. Open one to edit, pin or archive it.
memory.emptyDesc: Enable data collection and run learning once, or jot something down manually.
memory.emptyFilteredDesc: Try another keyword or loosen the filters.
memory.pinRowHint: Pinned memories never decay and are always recalled first.
memory.archiveRowHint: Archived memories drop out of recall but stay on record and can be restored anytime.
memory.deleteRowHint: Permanently delete this memory. This cannot be undone.
memory.composeSubtitle: Only for this companion — no other companion sees it
memory.composeKindHint: The kind decides how this memory is weighted and how it decays during recall.
memory.mergeSubtitle: Fold memories that say the same thing into one

memories.editHint: Edits apply to new conversations and live recall; an already-open chat keeps the memory snapshot it started with.
memories.addPlaceholder: Tell nomi something it should remember…
memories.reclassifyPick: Pick a new kind for the {{count}} selected memories
memories.mergeHint: For each group, pick the entries to merge, edit the merged text, then confirm. Merged sources are archived (never deleted).

remote.accessHint: Reach {{companionName}} from outside the desktop app: external MCP / REST clients connect as it with an access token.
remote.accessTokenGrant: Anyone holding this token acts as {{companionName}} on the remote API: reading and writing its memories, invoking its skills, starting conversations on its behalf, and anything else the remote API exposes — effectively full control of this companion. Treat it like a password and revoke it the moment it leaks.
remote.accessRegenerateConfirm: Regenerating invalidates the old token immediately and disconnects any external client still using it. Continue?
remote.accessRegenerateUnknownConfirm: We can't tell right now whether this companion already has an access token. If it does, generating a new one invalidates the old token immediately and disconnects any external client still using it. Continue?

evolution.loadFailed: Learning and evolution settings are temporarily unavailable.
evolution.learningDesc: This companion reviews your work records on the schedule below and files what it distills under its own name.
evolution.learnEnabledDesc: When off, periodic learning stops; memories and skills already distilled are left untouched.
evolution.modelDesc: The chat model used to review records and distill memories and skills.
evolution.modelMissing: No model selected — learning and skill generation won't run.
evolution.modelStale: The selected {{model}} is no longer in the available model list, so learning will fail — please pick another.
evolution.intervalDesc: How often new records are reviewed.
evolution.skillDesc: Distills your repeated multi-step actions into this companion's own skills, using the learning model above.
evolution.skillEnabledDesc: When off, no new skills are generated; existing skills keep working.
evolution.minSessionsDesc: The same sequence of actions has to show up in at least this many sessions before it becomes a skill.
evolution.preferenceDesc: Decides whether new skills wait for your review or activate directly when confidence is high.
evolution.preferenceConservativeDesc: Every new skill is saved as a draft and only activates once you confirm it in the Skills tab.
evolution.preferenceAggressiveDesc: High-confidence skills activate straight away; the rest stay drafts (you can disable any of them in the Skills tab).
evolution.quietSectionDesc: Give this companion a quiet window: it will not reach out, and its background learning rests too.
evolution.quietRangeDesc: During this window the desktop companion stops popping bubbles at you and unread notices pile up on its badge; scheduled learning and skill generation are skipped until it wakes. Incoming messages are still answered. Leave it empty to allow interruptions all day.

history.sectionDesc: This companion’s conversations are read day by day in your local dates. With “Session archiving” on (a global setting that applies to every companion, off by default), that day’s diary appears above the messages.
history.selectDay: Pick a day on the left to start reading.
history.emptyDay: No messages to show for this day.
history.emptyHint: Once you exchange a first message with this companion, the conversation shows up here day by day.
history.loadFailedHint: This companion's conversation records couldn't be read — the backend may be temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
history.onThisDayHint: Session diaries from the same day ({{day}}) in past years
history.onThisDayArchiveNote: Diaries come from “Session archiving” (a global setting that applies to every companion, off by default); without it this stays empty.
history.onThisDayFailed: Couldn't read past-year diaries — the backend may be temporarily unavailable.
history.onThisDayFailedHint: Leaving and coming back retries it.
history.dayIndexSummary: {{days}} days · {{count}} messages — that is all of it.
history.dayLoadFailed: This day did not load — tap to retry
history.dayTruncatedHint: This day is long; showing only its earliest {{count}} messages.

other.migrateSectionDesc: Pack this companion up for another device, or restore a companion from a bundle.
other.exportDesc: Pack “{{companionName}}” into a .zip bundle and import it on another device to restore it. Its settings, growth progress, bound knowledge-base names and custom figure image are always in the bundle; memories and skills are up to you. Chat history is not included.
other.importDesc: Pick a companion bundle (.zip) to create a new companion here and rebind its knowledge bases by name.
other.dangerSectionDesc: Nothing here can be undone — confirm before you run it.
other.deleteHint: Permanently deletes “{{companionName}}” along with its memories, skills, growth progress and chat history.
other.deleteConfirmBody: “{{companionName}}”’s settings, every memory it holds under Memory, its skills, growth progress and chat history are all deleted permanently and cannot be recovered. The bundle above can carry its settings, memories and skills, but chat history is not in it, so exporting first will not keep that.

danger.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes “{{companionName}}” together with all of its memories, skills, growth progress and chat history, and cannot be undone. Note: the migration bundle can carry settings, memories and skills, but chat history is not in it, so exporting first will not keep that.

archive.onThisDayEmpty: No records from this day in past years yet.

chat.modelConfigHint: This companion's chat model. Applies everywhere (local chat and remote connections); switching updates all its sessions.
chat.modelMissing: Configure a chat model for this companion first
chat.modelNoTextModel: No text model available for chat. Image models can't be used as a chat model — add a text model in Model Management.
chat.modelProviderNoChat: This provider has no text model usable for chat (image models can't be a chat model).
chat.modelStale: The current chat model "{{model}}" is no longer available — please pick another.
chat.clearContextHint: Clears this session only; memories are kept
chat.clearContextConfirmBody: This wipes all messages in this session (memories are kept). Continue?
chat.empty: Your private session with this companion — say hi
chat.clearConfirm: Clear all chat history and the rolling summary?

robot.title: Robot connection
robot.hint: Attach a physical robot to {{companionName}}: it speaks with this companion's persona, models and memories.
robot.otaStep: 1. Open the robot's Wi-Fi setup page and set the OTA address under Advanced settings to one of these:
robot.otaNone: No LAN address is available yet.
robot.codeStep: 2. On boot the robot shows and reads out a 6-digit activation code. Enter it here:
robot.claimOk: The robot is now bound to {{companionName}}
robot.claimNotFound: No such activation code, or it has expired — check the number on the robot's screen again.
robot.claimTaken: This robot is already bound to another companion. Unbind it there first.
robot.lanOff: The robot needs LAN access turned on before it can reach this computer.
robot.lanEnableFailed: Failed to turn on LAN access
robot.lanUnavailable: Turn on LAN access from the desktop app.
robot.unbindConfirm: After unbinding, this robot belongs to no companion and shows an activation code again, waiting to be claimed.
robot.removeConfirm: Deleting revokes the device token immediately; the robot has to report in and be bound again.
robot.loadFailed: Could not read the robot list — check that the robot service is running.

settings.nameHint: What your companion is called — shown in chat and on the desktop companion
settings.presetHint: Apply a saved Agent, model, Skill and knowledge configuration to this companion in one step.
settings.personaCustomPlaceholder: Extra persona notes (optional), e.g. call me "Captain"
settings.companionEnabledHint: Show your companion on the desktop (transparent always-on-top window, desktop only)

settings.knowledgeHint: Mount knowledge bases for {{companionName}} to consult and write back during chat

settings.remoteBindConfirm: After binding, this bot is answered by {{companionName}} and the channel's active sessions are reset.

settings.remoteDeleteConfirm: Delete this bot? Its connection stops, the channel's sessions are cleared and the configuration is removed.
settings.remoteOtherBots: {{num}} IM bot(s) already answered by other companions: {{companions}}

settings.remoteBindFailed: Failed to save the greeter setting
settings.remoteEnableChannelHint: Start or stop this channel's bot connection
settings.remoteMoveConfirm: This bot currently belongs to "{{from}}". Move it to "{{to}}"? Its channel sessions will be reset.
